scope: Connected BOSH response bind, exposure/cache, cached replay renewal and fresh acknowledgement ownership; formatted source milestone only.
manifest_encoding: UTF-8 JSON, sorted object keys, compact separators, no trailing newline
implemented_source: Closed bind, renewal and acknowledgement requests flow through the existing service/repository/SQL calls; transaction-derived receipt facts are recorded immediately after the existing COMMIT.

Private response helpers own selected OutboundItems through binding; those items drop when preparation returns, while response Bytes, capacity owners and receipt channels survive exposure/cache. Actor authentication publication remains between exposure and cache bookkeeping.

Cached replay retains its pre-renewal counter and exact membership; fresh acknowledgement renews first, then evicts the covered cache prefix and sends existing receipt channels only after the observed return.
Known pre-COMMIT typed supersession is the only bind restoration/rebuild path; completed matching restorations compact lineage while active or committed/unknown facts remain retained.
Private immutable Arc membership shares the actual returned value with the cache continuation; it is distinct from independently prepared SQL receipt authority.
Empty pause and terminal control observations retain factual responder results without issuing durable effects or payload continuations.
